benchmark.scope: four complete one-record shards only; no full run

disk.stage_2_go_no_go: after stage 1, require at least 143 GB free (stage-2 hard ceiling plus 20 GB margin); otherwise stop
disk.optional_global_merge: not required for a scalar linear consumer; if requested, budget a separate output roughly up to the input estimate and gate it separately

restartability.unit: one source record with a unique attempt prefix
restartability.acceptance: complete_source_range=true atomic manifest plus verification of every sorted part and a stage-catalog SHA256
restartability.orphan_policy: ignore an orphan part without a manifest; retry using a new attempt prefix; never overwrite
restartability.parallel_safety: workers read shared frozen inputs but write disjoint record/attempt prefixes

H_compression.verdict: do not use on the authoritative export
H_compression.reason: H permutes the 223/232/322 packet labels; the current scalar key aggregates them and retains only one minimal packet witness, not a three-component equivariant weight. Canonicalizing further would not be source-faithful per ID.
H_compression.allowed_derived_use: after the raw grouped artifact is frozen, an H-invariant scalar charge may be evaluated on H-orbits with a separate exact equivariance referee
